function.description: Run weighted least-squares state estimation on the current user snapshot. Do not resend z_obs in the tool arguments.
function.name: wls_from_path

function.description: Retrieve repeated measurement scans and initial states needed for parameter correction. Returns a compact summary while the runtime binds the full arrays for the next tool call.
function.name: get_parameter_context

function.description: Retrieve compact breaker context for topology correction.
function.name: get_topology_context

function.description: Retrieve harmonic measurements and orders for harmonic follow-up. Returns a compact summary while the runtime binds the full measurements for HSE.
function.name: get_harmonic_context

function.description: Verify the open transactional candidate. Optionally provide its candidate case identifier; otherwise the controller binds the open candidate alias.
function.name: get_verification_snapshot

case_path.description: Optional candidate case identifier to verify.

function.description: Correct suspected bad measurements using the current user snapshot. Provide the suspect group only; the wrapper will hydrate z_obs.
function.name: correct_measurements_from_path

function.description: Correct line-parameter errors after the user provides repeated measurement scans and initial states. Do not repeat those arrays in the tool call.
function.name: correct_parameters_from_path

function.description: Correct a suspected topology mismatch using a breaker name and desired status.
function.name: correct_topology_from_path

function.description: Run harmonic state estimation after the user provides harmonic measurements. Do not repeat the full harmonic payload in the tool call.
function.name: run_hse_from_path

function.description: Run compact three-phase NLM high-impedance-fault localization evidence. Do not repeat OpenDSS models or measurement arrays in the tool arguments.
function.name: run_three_phase_nlm_from_path

function.description: Estimate HIF position along a suspected IEEE-14 line and estimate HIF magnitude using model-based OpenDSS residual fitting. Do not repeat measurement arrays in the tool arguments.
function.name: estimate_hif_location_magnitude_from_path

candidate_branch_row0.description: Zero-based IEEE-14 branch row selected by the line-level HIF locator.

candidate_phase.description: Optional phase hint. If omitted or null, all phases are searched.

function.description: Estimate shared HIF position, phase, and resistance from a persistent IEEE-14 scan window, with scan-selection and observability diagnostics. Do not repeat measurement arrays in the tool arguments.
function.name: estimate_hif_location_magnitude_multiscan_from_path

candidate_branch_row0.description: Zero-based IEEE-14 branch row selected by the line-level HIF locator.

candidate_phase.description: Optional phase hint. If omitted or null, all phases are searched.

scan_window_path.description: Path or runtime-bound identifier for the persistent HIF scan window.

function.description: Retrieve observable measurement-residual context for bad-data correction on the referenced case.
function.name: get_measurement_context

function.description: Commit a verified acceptable candidate case.
function.name: commit_state

case_path.description: Candidate case identifier or path to commit.

function.description: Roll back a verified rejected or inconclusive candidate case.
function.name: rollback_state

case_path.description: Candidate case identifier or path to roll back.

function.description: Finish only after observable evidence shows no material anomaly remains.
function.name: finalize_diagnosis

function.description: Request additional observable evidence for the referenced case.
function.name: ask_for_more_evidence

function.description: Run an alternative observable diagnostic test on the referenced case.
function.name: run_alternative_test
